Method of Attack: Heap buffer overflow caused by sending a specially crafted image with a large size while fooling the Instagram app into believing it’s much smaller, leading to memory corruption and potential remote code execution.
Exploitation via sending malicious image through email, WhatsApp, SMS, or other messaging services, triggering the bug when the image is accessed or uploaded in Instagram.
Attack Vector: Malicious image sent via common messaging platforms or email
Indicators of Compromise: Specially crafted image triggering heap buffer overflow in Instagram app
